```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(raster)
library(here)
library(ggplot2)
library(devtools)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)

t_crs<-"+proj=aea +lat_1=-9 +lat_2=-26 +lat_0=-17 +lon_0=180 +x_0=0 +y_0=0 +ellps=WGS84 +datum=WGS84 +units=m +no_defs"
```

# Population estimates vs. reported plot

```{r}
pop_check<-read_csv(here("output_data/Sewage_plants/STP_population_check.csv")) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(estimated) == T) %>% 
  mutate(label = ifelse(STP == "Deuba WWTP", "Pacific Harbor",
                        ifelse(STP == "Kinoya WWTP", "Kinoya",
                               ifelse(STP == "Nadali WWTP", "Rewa",
                                      ifelse(STP == "Namara TP", "Labasa",
                                             ifelse(STP == "Natabua WWTP", "Natabua",
                                                    ifelse(STP == "Navakai WWTP", "Nadi",
                                                           ifelse(STP == "Olosara", "Sigatoka",
                                                                  ifelse(STP == "Votua WWTP", "Ba", NA)))))))))
```

```{r}
ggplot(pop_check, aes(x = reported/1000, y = estimated/1000, col = label)) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  ylab("Estimated population (thousands)") +
  xlab("Reported population (thousands)") +
  stat_smooth(method = "lm", col = "black", linetype = "dashed") +
  theme_bw() +
  labs(colour="Wastewater\ntreatment plant")
```
```{r}
ggsave(here("figures/Supp_reported_estimated_WWTP_population.png"), dpi =300, width = 8, height = 5,)
```


# Leaching rate/distance from rivers sensitivity plot

```{r}
n_septic_sens<-read.csv(here("output_data/Sensitivity/Leaching_buffer_sensitivity.csv")) %>% 
  filter(type == "septic") %>% 
  mutate(buffer2 = as.character(buffer),
         N_tonnes = N * 0.001,
         z = ifelse(buffer == 50 & leach_rate == 0.1, TRUE, FALSE)) 

n_septic_heatmap <- ggplot(data = n_septic_sens, mapping = aes(x = as.factor(buffer),
                                                       y = leach_rate)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = N_tonnes)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(N_tonnes, 2), color=as.factor(z))) +
  scale_color_manual(guide = FALSE, values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  xlab(label = "") + 
  ylab(label = "Leaching rate (%)") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(fill="Nitrogen", title = "Septic") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete=FALSE, direction=-1) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
  

n_septic_heatmap
```


```{r}
p_septic_sens<-read.csv(here("output_data/Sensitivity/Leaching_buffer_sensitivity.csv")) %>% 
  filter(type == "septic") %>% 
  mutate(buffer2 = as.character(buffer),
         P_tonnes = P * 0.001,
         z = ifelse(buffer == 50 & leach_rate == 0.1, TRUE, FALSE)) 

p_septic_heatmap <- ggplot(data = p_septic_sens, mapping = aes(x = as.factor(buffer),
                                                       y = leach_rate)) +
  geom_tile(aes(fill = P_tonnes)) +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(P_tonnes, 2), color=as.factor(z))) +
  scale_color_manual(guide = FALSE, values = c(`TRUE` = "red", `FALSE` = "black")) +
  xlab(label = "Distance from river (m)") + 
  ylab(label = "Leaching rate (%)") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  labs(fill="Phosphorus") + 
  scale_fill_viridis(discrete=FALSE, direction=-1) 
  

p_septic_heatmap
```

# Change in N/P with increasing distance

```{r}
buffer_dat<-read.csv(here("output_data/Sensitivity/Leaching_buffer_sensitivity.csv")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(., col = c("N", "P"), names_to = "Nutrients") %>% 
  mutate(value = value * 0.001) %>% 
  filter(leach_rate == 0.1)

```

```{r}
buffer_sens<-ggplot(buffer_dat, aes(x = buffer, y = value, col = Nutrients)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~type) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Buffer distance (meters)") +
  ylab("Nutrients (tonnes)")

buffer_sens
```


# Change in N/P with increasing leaching rate

```{r}
leach_dat<-read.csv(here("output_data/Sensitivity/Leaching_buffer_sensitivity.csv")) %>% 
  pivot_longer(., col = c("N", "P"), names_to = "Nutrients") %>% 
  mutate(value = value * 0.001) %>% 
  filter(buffer == 50)

```

```{r}
leach_sens<-ggplot(leach_dat, aes(x = leach_rate, y = value, col = Nutrients)) +
  geom_point() +
  facet_wrap(~type) +
  theme_bw() +
  xlab("Leaching rate (%)") +
  ylab("Nutrients (tonnes)") 

leach_sens
```

```{r}
buffer_sens/leach_sens + plot_annotation(tag_levels = 'A')
```

```{r}
ggsave(here("figures/Supp_leach_buffer_sensitivity_line_graph.png"), dpi =300, width = 10, height = 10)
```
